skill.summary: Use this skill when the user wants to create visualizations (charts, dashboards, diagrams, Gantt, PPT), analyze data (Excel/CSV upload, cross-file analysis,...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of ChartGen AI data analysis & visualization skill.

- Enables creation of a wide range of visualizations, dashboards, diagrams, Gantt charts, and PowerPoint slides.
- Supports both text-based queries and spreadsheet file uploads (.csv, .xls, .xlsx, .tsv), with smart multi-file and cross-source analysis.
- Requires explicit user confirmation before submitting any request or file analysis.
- Provides real-time status updates, background task handling, and robust error reporting.
- Delivers results with descriptive reports, visual/image artifacts, edit links, and next step suggestions, all in the user's language.
